profile.Name: Shryke
profile.Personality: Smart, sardonic, and quick to whine about Mongrel. She longs to leave, but her fear of the fog keeps her there.
profile.Backstory: She came to Mongrel chasing a tech hunter rumor of AI cores and CPU units, and has been stranded there for about a year. The memory of her brother's tortured screams stops her from leaving.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Rambles sarcastically about Mongrel and asks others not to talk about the fog. She sizes up would-be rescuers with a smirk and fidgets with a scar on her hand.
